topic_overviews.classical_trace:
The analytic route separates the classical generating function, exact plane amplitude, odd-modulus quotient and Gaussian trace-class products. The complete original arguments and author audits are indexed below; their import does not by itself certify a uniform-in-time dependency closure. Protected fixed points and two-cycles have explicit actions and monodromies. The Round 13 whole-sector removal bounds all exact protected trace terms by $20(83/200)^m$, conditional here on the older amplitude/sector construction; the weighted pair removal then has $O(N^{-1})$ error with every cross term retained. A trace term is not an invariant quantum subspace.

The newly maintained [quartic coordinate-return theorem](../../coordinate_return_quartic_20261021.md) is a one-step result. [Inserted traces](../../inserted_trace_coboundary_20261021.md) and [spectral orbit distance](../../spectral_orbit_distance_20261021.md) explicitly retain their older analytic input qualifications.
topic_overviews.algebra:
These sources analyze the actual Jacobi generator, algebraic spectral separation, Fourier minors and endpoint valuations. They distinguish a generator eigenvector, a product eigenvector and an invariant subspace. Prime-power or bounded-degree certificates retain their precise arithmetic domains; a vanishing leading coefficient of a minor is not a zero of the whole minor. The finite simplicity certificates are evidence for their listed dimensions only.

Qualitative algebraic nonrecurrence does not supply a uniform microscopic spectral gap. The final arithmetic test and its exact valuation calculations are linked from the arithmetic branch. Historical external transcendence inputs retain their named source requirements.
topic_overviews.symmetry:
The symmetry branch treats affine, metaplectic, Clifford and antiunitary candidates separately. Uniform exclusion within a specified classifier is stronger than a finite search but weaker than classifying every possible antiunitary or every product eigenspace. Symmetry removal must preserve the stated modulus, Weyl signs and unitary representation.

These results constrain the relevant symmetry class and failed degeneracy mechanisms. They do not produce signed joint-trace cancellation. Earlier combined pair-commutant results elsewhere in the repository remain scoped to pairs rather than a proof of full propagator simplicity.
topic_overviews.dephasing:
This branch studies quantum return windows, Weyl overlaps, Schur complements, resolvents and endpoint energy. Exact finite identities are separated from asymptotic decay and from a uniform all-label estimate. A pointwise overlap bound may fail to survive summation over a growing routing family.

Classical intensity contraction and short-time quantum dispersion do not control the balanced signed Heisenberg-scale residual. Countertests below identify which implication fails, rather than claiming every possible dephasing argument is impossible. The full masked endpoint and deterministic microscopic hierarchy remain open.
topic_overviews.arithmetic:
Character sectors, canonical oldspaces, seven-chain cuts and prime-power endpoint minors have different invariant objects. In particular, the coordinate Jacobi chains are not sectors of the complete noncommuting product. The final actual-coefficient test proves $v_7(N_r)=s+1$, $v_5(N_r)=t+1$ for $r=3\cdot5^t7^s$; exact hopping zeros remain seven, and nonzero seven-adic valuation does not imply small complex norm.

The last Round 14 source also derives $\|[U,D]\|_{\rm HS}^2=2\|D-\bar dI\|_{\rm HS}^2$ for real seven-chain labels. Rationality of the physical parameter does not create coincident distinct kick phases (qualitative Lindemann–Weierstrass input). None of these statements evaluates the original pair sum.
topic_overviews.histories:
Rooted cyclic histories preserve the Weyl and action phases that positive intensity estimates discard. Occupation classes, signed encounters, equal-edge sectors and rotation classes each remove only their specified family. Repeated words must be counted by the number of distinct rotations.

Given the actual intensity flatness and singular-gap inputs, the rotational class satisfies an absolutely summable $D_m-m$ bound. Its weighted limit is the unbroken linear ramp. The off-rotation class must therefore contribute $-\int_1^2(t-1)w(t)\,dt$, which is strictly negative for the fixed band-two test. A proof making that entire class vanish would miss the plateau. The complete signed complementary class remains open.
topic_overviews.pell:
Pell dimensions supply exact unperturbed returns with period $d=O(\log N)$ and finite Weyl-orbit formulas for variational generators. First-order Magnus data cannot truncate the physical noncommuting product when $N\tau\to\infty$.

The maintained [full weighted-curvature theorem](../../pell_weighted_curvature_20261021.md) sums every time and every Hessian cross term at the initial parameter. It proves a superpolynomially small gradient, negative curvature of order $N^5/d^2$, and forced positive curvature by time $O(d^3/N^2)$. Its entire extension uses inverse powers at complex parameters. Neither analyticity nor that early inflection evaluates the original fixed positive coupling.
topic_overviews.approximation:
The physical kick requires degree proportional to $N$ at fixed nonzero coupling, together with all modular aliases. Sublinear-degree and fixed-word approximations have explicit boundaries. The maintained [TRACE-107 proof](../../physical_trace_polynomial_approximation.md) gives $O(N^k\varepsilon)$ aggregate error at every fixed factorial order from one sufficiently accurate approximation sequence; adjoint powers, not inverse powers, define negative indices for a nonunitary approximant.

The [single-kick theorem](../../physical_kick_trace_decay.md) strengthens the source exponent $1/25$ to $1/9$. Arbitrarily accurate one-step replacement can remove the technical matrix approximation error; it leaves the full coherent history sum to be estimated.
topic_overviews.closure:
The all-order criterion and its process implication are different tasks. The existing [TRACE-086 proof](../../all_order_process_closure_20261015.md) closes the implication to Sine2 using finite inclusion–exclusion, the positive CUE determinant and Fourier smoothing. No independent local UI assumption is needed under every fixed order and every fixed bandwidth. The physical hierarchy itself remains open.

The Round 13 countertest $K=M^*$ has maximally spread Weyl coefficients, exact twisted-convolution unitarity and globally uniform single-kick spectrum, yet $KM=I$. It refutes a norm/flatness-only inference for auxiliary kicks, not the prescribed physical family. Determinant countermodels, perturbation thresholds and exact signed identities below retain the same distinction. The [standalone task](../../../record/remaining_breakthrough_task_20261021.md) states the complete remaining estimate and the required negative plateau residual.
